findings: The hero long-exposure light-trail photograph (orange parabolic arc over a dark silhouetted horizon) flirts with generic stock-shot territory; it is only rescued by being tied to the 'arcs burned / plate open' conceit rather than being intrinsically distinctive.

The § 2 exposure legend ('one face 26 lx / three 25–26 ix / six since 14 ix / nine since 5 ix') uses a radio-button-style list that reads slightly UI-generic against the otherwise editorial-print voice.

The middle stack (§ 3 RealWorld.fi / ActualSales two-column, § 4 label runs) relaxes the strong asymmetric tension of the hero into a more conventional vertical magazine flow — competent but less daring than the top.
The § 2 ghosted double 'André Macedo' portrait plate is atmospheric but muddy at this scale; its content hierarchy is hard to parse.
what_works: Decisive daguerreotype / long-exposure conceit carried end-to-end: 'plate i · 24 iii 2026 → now · 107 arcs burned', §-numbered plates, and a Telos AI narrator voice — an editorial spine no template generator would invent.
High-contrast Didone display ('André Macedo', 'Star Trail') set against an Iowan body serif and a lowercase mono utility voice — a genuine three-register typographic system, not default sans.

Asymmetric hero: heavy left-aligned display name + contact block held in tension against the full-bleed dark photograph on the right, with a mono metadata strip anchoring the base — a composed relationship, not a centered headline.
Disciplined near-monochrome palette (ink/navy-black paper) governed by a single warm amber accent used sparingly ('stood still', the arc, active-state marks) — restrained and coherent.
Stranger test cleanly satisfied: name, dual co-founder role, and me@andremacedo.com all legible above the fold without interaction.
A.reasoning: This is an editorial art-organism, not a SaaS shell: an asymmetric dark hero pairs a high-contrast Didone name with a mono AI-narrator metadata strip over a thematically-justified long-exposure photograph, and the daguerreotype 'held the plate open' conceit runs through numbered plates to the footer. Type craft, composition, and the single-accent palette all show intentional conviction well beyond template default, and the stranger-test floor is met with name/role/email in the first viewport. It loses a little as the mid-page settles into a more conventional stacked magazine flow and the hero image leans on a somewhat familiar light-trail motif, but nothing here is generic, centered-symmetry, gradient-card slop.
